why: Install, join, update, rollback, uninstall, purge, doctor, the installed command and optional HTTPS are implemented. The complete browser matrix passed 116 checks in 30.3 minutes, including all four guided packed installations. Each installed copy preserved 227 notice files. The backend run passed 973 cases with three test-boundary failures and one live-key skip; all four affected cases passed after fixture-only corrections. Typecheck and lint pass. Providers, physical devices and the newer release are simulated where labelled; live credentials, commit approval and publication remain blocked. See docs/acceptance/phase5-first-run.md. Post-handoff Claude login recovery fix is active after the user-approved restart. Accounts, passphrase and conversation ledgers are preserved; successful user sign-in remains pending. See docs/acceptance/login-recovery-2026-09-25.md. Workflow repair prepared: Claude tool discovery, indexed activity scan, real progress, compact conversation UI and server folder picker. Workflow repair is deployed at the existing Tailscale URL with account/authentication/project/ledger preservation checks passing; real Jev classification and Claude implementation are running; see docs/acceptance/workflow-repair-2026-09-25.md. Completed pilot and deployed repairs committed as 3d1c3fb and pushed publicly; secret scan and existing-repository visibility comparison passed. Live review exposed native read-only MCP handoff denial; explicit scoped approval fix passed 54 safety/execution cases and was deployed at 20:10 UTC. Live review handed off successfully; Jev selected Done and independent verification passed 17/17 tests with stable HEAD/files. Exact stretch numbers are now supplied in briefs, repair prompts and mismatch responses. Final release passed all 79 targeted checks and was deployed with source-match and account/history preservation checks passing. Git connection repair deployed on 2026-09-26: isolated per-device Settings → Git preferences, SSH transport and a read-only project check. The live sequoias connection passes; 71 focused backend checks and four browser layouts pass. See docs/acceptance/git-settings-2026-09-26.md.

why: Rename and persistent ordering for native and ordinary sessions. Saved names/order remain shared by browsers using this installation. Automated and physical-touch tests not run under the user’s preference. See docs/acceptance/session-list-controls-2026-09-29.md.

title: Shared native and ordinary conversation presentation
why: Latest main confirmed, including the other machine’s clean checkout. Ordinary and native sessions share formatted chronological transcripts, readable tool inputs/results, expanded thinking and compact spacing.
